# nemau_pool (Resource)

A group of backends behind a load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_pool" "web" {
  load_balancer_id = nemau_load_balancer.edge.id
  name             = "web"
  protocol         = "HTTP"
  lb_algorithm     = "ROUND_ROBIN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `lb_algorithm` (String) `ROUND_ROBIN`, `LEAST_CONNECTIONS` or `SOURCE_IP`. Changes in place.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Id of the load balancer the pool belongs to.
- `name` (String) Pool name. Changes in place.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol the load balancer uses to reach the members: `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `TCP` or `UDP`. It must suit the listener: a `TERMINATED_HTTPS` listener forwards to an `HTTP` pool, and an `HTTPS` listener to an `HTTPS` or `TCP` pool.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state, `true` by default; `false` takes the pool out of service. Changing it replaces the pool.
- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.
- `listener_id` (String) Id of a listener to attach the pool to at creation. A listener can also point at the pool with `default_pool_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pool id.
- `operating_status` (String) Operating status as reported by the platform.
